publications.explanation:
Axis Bank announced MicroPay on 23 March 2023, working with Ezetap by Razorpay and MyPinpad. A small card reader connects to the merchant’s smartphone by Bluetooth, while the customer enters the PIN on the phone. The phone therefore serves as part of the point-of-sale setup. “Recently” refers to this 2023 launch, which identifies Axis Bank among the choices.

[Axis Bank’s launch announcement](https://www.axis.bank.in/about-us/press-releases/axis-bank-launches-micropay-india-s-first-pocket-sized-swipe-machine-based-on-pin-on-mobile-technology-30-cost-effective-than-traditional-pos-devices).

Update — checked 9 November 2026: Axis Bank’s current merchant-payments page lists a wider range of payment tools, including Android and pocket terminals, soundboxes and the neo for merchants app. This is useful follow-up reading; the historical launch answer remains Axis Bank. [Current payment solutions](https://www.axis.bank.in/business-banking/in-store-payment-acceptance).
